title: Grateful Dead Live at Des Moines State Fairgrounds on 1973-05-13
lineage: MSR>R>?>C>DAT>WAV>SHN except for 4th disc/end of second set which is from previously circulated SHN set.

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture with a bit of hiss but an unforgettable three‑set performance highlighted by a massive Other One, Eyes of the World and the rain‑to‑sunshine magic.
ai_review.review: The show is repeatedly called one of the best early‑’73 outings – fans rave about the soaring Other One, the lush Eyes, the sunshine after the rain, and marathon jams in Playing In The Band.  The SBD source is a little louder and hissier than alternate tapes, yet it remains listenable enough to let the band’s energy shine through.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen reviews praise the musical performance (many 5‑star) while noting only modest recording flaws; the consensus is a stellar show with acceptable soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: A bit louder and hissier than other sources; some reviewers call it “Jerry‑centric” and wish for less hiss, but overall the tape is listenable and captures the performance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon with a rain‑to‑rainbow moment that kept the crowd energized; the second set builds into epic jams and the encore (Casey Jones) caps a flawless night.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mix is Jerry‑centric, his guitar solos and noodling are highlighted throughout, especially during The Other One.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass noted for “cello‑like” tones that add depth to the jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s piano on Eyes of the World praised as McCoy Tyner‑style; overall keyboard work adds richness.
